title: Trezor confirms email vendor compromise enabling phishing campaign targeting crypto users
content_md:
Trezor confirms that one of its email service providers was compromised and that a phishing campaign under the guise of a "Critical Security Update" is underway, similar to the 2024 incident.

via Mastodon https://www.reddit.com/r/Bitcoin/comments/1wbxorx/whats_going_on_with_trezor/
